properties.decision:
PROPOSED FOR ANTHONY'S WORD. Two places where what the ledger counts as a cue and what an agent reads as one disagree, measured 2026-10-30 (fact:the-served-tools-sorted-by-their-counts-109-used-5-cued-unfollowed-40-never-reached-6-steps-39-close-2026-10-30):
(a) describe_schema's per-edge-type `hint` is reference text (which tool writes this edge), yet the ledger counts each tool it names as a cue offered: in the 0.94.0 writers, 11 offers each for apply_heal, claim_region, gap_to_prompt, gaps_to_prompts, get_node, get_skill:parallel-work, open_questions, propagate_from, propose_heal, plus 2 each for add_inference, reconcile_artifacts and reconcile_deployment — 105 of the 683 offers (15%), followed within 5 calls once (get_node). They lower the follow rate increment 3 reported (3.8%) without being cues anyone was asked to follow.
(b) mint_seat's reply says "Pass this as `seat` on claim_region" under `carry_it`, which is not a cue field, and it is the most-followed pointer in the sample: 38 of 38 mint_seat runs on flo2.io were followed by claim_region. The best cue reflow2 has is uncounted.
OPTIONS: A. Leave both; note them beside the numbers. B. Count only replies' own cue fields at their top level (or name describe_schema's field something other than `hint`), and add `carry_it` to the cue fields. C. Decide it as part of increment 6's one named cue message, where every cue gets one field. Recommendation: C, with B's two facts as its input, so the cue ids increment 6 compares stay stable until then.
properties.name: SETTLED 2026-10-30 — what the cue count counts (leave out describe_schema's reference hints, count mint_seat's carry_it) is decided inside increment 6's one named cue message
properties.rationale: Increment 6 keeps the cues the counts show are followed; if the count includes reference text and leaves out a followed pointer, it keeps and drops the wrong ones. Recorded rather than changed in increment 7's PR because changing what is counted would break the like-for-like comparison increment 6 depends on.
